source.notes: Roast & Rice Asian Fusion / Roast and Rice Kitchen (same restaurant POS, 15 pooled receipts). Guest checks print Table# / Server / items / Total Due / Gratuity Suggestion; card slips print Amount / Gratuity / Total plus the EMV block. The ROAST AND RICE KITCHEN wordmark is plain thermal text (no logo graphic). Rules shared by stylescan and the renderer.
